# Support

## Questions and bugs

- Read the [troubleshooting guide](../docs/troubleshooting.md) and the [install guide](../docs/guide/install.md) first.
- Run `/jobship:doctor` and include its output when you ask for help.
- Open a [bug report](https://github.com/andryorelabs/jobship/issues/new/choose) for something broken, or a feature request for something missing.

## Security

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. Report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
